name: KLOW Blend (BPC-157 + GHK-Cu + TB-500 + KPV)
storage: Store at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture.
definition: KLOW Blend (BPC-157 + GHK-Cu + TB-500 + KPV) is a multi-component peptide blend supplied as white lyophilized powder. The catalogue lists 1 pack size: 80 mg. The CAS number, full sequence and molecular weight are recorded in the lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA). Each unit combines BPC-157 10 mg, GHK-Cu 50 mg, TB-500 10 mg and KPV 10 mg. Purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC) with white lyophilized powder appearance. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: How is KLOW Blend (BPC-157 + GHK-Cu + TB-500 + KPV) tested for purity and identity?
faq.answer: KLOW Blend (BPC-157 + GHK-Cu + TB-500 + KPV) is released lot by lot — HPLC for purity (≥99.0% (HPLC)) plus MS for mass — and the KLOW certificate lists the measured values alongside the identity entry (CAS 137525-51-0 + 89030-95-5 + 885340-08-9 + 67727-97-3, formula C62H98N16O22 + C14H24CuN6O4 + C38H68N10O14 + C16H30N4O4, 1419.5 Da + 403.93 Da + 889 Da + 342.43 Da Da).

faq.question: How should KLOW Blend (BPC-157 + GHK-Cu + TB-500 + KPV) be stored?
faq.answer: KLOW Blend (BPC-157 + GHK-Cu + TB-500 + KPV) ships lyophilized and should stay at −20 °C until reconstitution; after that keep it at 2–8 °C and avoid freeze–thaw cycles.

faq.question: What pack sizes are available for KLOW Blend (BPC-157 + GHK-Cu + TB-500 + KPV)?
faq.answer: KLOW Blend (BPC-157 + GHK-Cu + TB-500 + KPV) is stocked in 1 pack size (80 mg), 10 vials per kit, MOQ 1 kit. At 1–9 kits the per-kit price is $292.48; 10–49 kits falls to $269.08 (−8%) and 50+ to $248.60 (−15%).
